name: JAC Japan map 15 km (settlers): historical relations and feud penalties are NOT applied

steps.code: local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName(),'^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; for _,f in ipairs({'OUCHI','OTOMO','HOJO','IMAGAWA','MORI','SHIMAZU','RYUKYU','TAKEDA','ODA'}) do if id[f]==nil then error('missing faction '..f) end end; local function st(a,b) return GameInfo.DiplomaticStates[Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticStateIndex(id[b])].StateType end; local function war(a,b) return Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(id[b]) end; local function feud(a,b) local n=0; local mods=Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticModifiers(id[b]); if mods then for _,t in ipairs(mods) do if t.Score==-10 then n=n+t.Score end end end return n end; if Game:GetProperty('JAC_JAPAN_1534_RELATIONS')~=nil then error('relations were applied on the settler map') end; if war('OUCHI','OTOMO') or war('OTOMO','OUCHI') then error('Ouchi-Otomo at war on the settler map') end; for _,pr in ipairs({{'HOJO','IMAGAWA'},{'SHIMAZU','RYUKYU'}}) do if st(pr[1],pr[2])=='DIPLO_STATE_DECLARED_FRIEND' then error(pr[1]..'-'..pr[2]..' friends on the settler map') end end; if feud('HOJO','TAKEDA')~=0 or feud('TAKEDA','HOJO')~=0 then error('feud penalty on the settler map') end; return 'start: settler map applies no relation and no feud penalty'

local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName(),'^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; for _,f in ipairs({'OUCHI','OTOMO','HOJO','IMAGAWA','MORI','SHIMAZU','RYUKYU','TAKEDA','ODA'}) do if id[f]==nil then error('missing faction '..f) end end; local function st(a,b) return GameInfo.DiplomaticStates[Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticStateIndex(id[b])].StateType end; local function war(a,b) return Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(id[b]) end; local function feud(a,b) local n=0; local mods=Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticModifiers(id[b]); if mods then for _,t in ipairs(mods) do if t.Score==-10 then n=n+t.Score end end end return n end; if Game:GetProperty('JAC_JAPAN_1534_RELATIONS')~=nil then error('relations were applied on the settler map') end; if war('OUCHI','OTOMO') or war('OTOMO','OUCHI') then error('Ouchi-Otomo at war on the settler map') end; for _,pr in ipairs({{'HOJO','IMAGAWA'},{'SHIMAZU','RYUKYU'}}) do if st(pr[1],pr[2])=='DIPLO_STATE_DECLARED_FRIEND' then error(pr[1]..'-'..pr[2]..' friends on the settler map') end end; if feud('HOJO','TAKEDA')~=0 or feud('TAKEDA','HOJO')~=0 then error('feud penalty on the settler map') end; return 'after 1 turn: still nothing applied'
